verdict.rationale: The evidence presents LangGraph as a low-level orchestration framework built from State, Nodes and Edges. Nothing in the pack documents typed custom tool definitions or a few-line agent constructor. The community note that tools are optional LangChain add-ons and that nodes are 'just functions' only describes building blocks. The MCPAdapter material covers LangChain agents consuming MCP tools, which belongs to a different story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define an agent with typed custom tools in a few lines of code
